description: This Java class 'EventListeners' manages a list of global property listeners within the OpenMRS API. It provides methods to get, set, and reset the static list of listeners.

classes.name: EventListeners
classes.description: Handles registration and management of global property event listeners in OpenMRS.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyListeners
methods.description: Returns the current list of global property listeners.

methods.name: setGlobalPropertyListeners
methods.description: Adds new listeners to the existing list, logging the operation if debug is enabled.

methods.name: setGlobalPropertyListenersToEmpty
methods.description: Resets the static list of listeners to null or clears it to prevent memory leaks.
